missionPremise: Option A ( _decisions/2026-08-26_factory_model_law_and_option_a.md ): Bexar 48029 cad finishes on the current writer as a recorded Factory job in us-east4. Gate 3 of the drain card stopped because no engine writer job exists. This lane builds that runner (image by digest, Factory-written run row, store-read counts, one 1,000-row canary) and hands the full resume back. Operator go 2026-08-27: give me the writer job and I will give it to a new agent. OPS-19 A-002.
completionPredicate: factory-atoms-writer exists in us-east4 on a digest; three refusal executions, one dry run, and exactly one --apply --limit=1000 on 48029 are named Cloud Run executions with Factory run rows; counts come from a SELECT; lease observed during and released after; close artifact names digest, job, script, run ids, atoms/s; drain lane owns the full resume.
scopeBasis: F-02 stage runner plus the F-03 run-row/termination wiring this job needs. No packages/ change. No county but 48029. No apply beyond the one canary. No laptop --apply. No F-15..F-18. No F-04 operator-login proxy. Drain and primary factory worktrees are not opened.

adversarialFindings.finding: seat/property-writer already has 62c1c4a (engine) and b0f0478 (factory). Engine commit added packages/engine-core/scripts/atoms-writer-job.mjs and put FACTORY_DATABASE_URL on the engine job image. Factory commit added bexar-cad.mjs targeting factory-atoms-cad with RUN_ID as an env var and counts from gcloud exit. All three violate the card (no packages/ change; engine image never holds FACTORY_DATABASE_URL; job name factory-atoms-writer; --run-id arg; counts from SELECT).
adversarialFindings.disposition: revert packages/ to origin/main. Replace Dockerfile.atoms-writer and cloudbuild with the card paths. Add atoms-writer-run.mjs and scripts/jobs/atoms-writer.sh. Leave bexar-cad.mjs in tree unused; this lane does not deploy through it.
